use_case_name: Share a Geographic Pointer with Other Units

claims.content: To allow a C2 JU to filter tracks and nonC² IUs based on their geographic location by defining geographic filters such as circles, annuli, sectors, rectangles, lines, or nested rectangles.

goal.raw_text: To allow a C2 JU to filter tracks and nonC² IUs based on their geographic location by defining geographic filters such as circles, annuli, sectors, rectangles, lines, or nested rectangles.

claims.content: C2 JU

The C2 JU must have defined the geographic filter parameters (e.g., latitude/longitude origin, major/minor axes, bearings) according to the specific geometry type (Circle, Annulus, Sector, Rectangle, Line, etc.) as specified in Table 4.7-6.
If the filter is a Line or Area requiring multiple messages, the C2 JU must be prepared to treat all messages with the same filter number as a single filter report.
Voice coordination must be established in addition to the filter message to ensure filter management on the interface.
A C2 JU decides to filter tracks and nonC² IUs based on their geographic location.

trigger.raw_text: A C2 JU decides to filter tracks and nonC² IUs based on their geographic location.

claims.content: The C2 JU defines the geographic filter parameters (e.g., latitude/longitude origin, major/minor axes, bearings) according to the specific geometry type (Circle, Annulus, Sector, Rectangle, Line, etc.) as specified in Table 4.7-6.
If the filter is a Line or Area requiring multiple messages, the C2 JU treats all messages with the same filter number as a single filter report.
The C2 JU transmits the defined geographic filter data via J7.6 message(s) to other units.
Voice coordination is established in addition to the filter message to ensure proper filter management on the interface.
If specific filters have been prearranged, the C2 JU may request implementation by specifying the filter number with all Filter Indicator fields of the J7.6 (ACT = 0) set to value 0.
A new filter report on a previously received filter number from a JU shall supersede prior filter data for that number.

If a C2 JU initiates a request for filter data via J7.1 (ACT = 0), the responding JU must ensure that any subsequent J7.6 (ACT = 1) filter description report messages are addressed specifically to the requesting unit.

When a JU responds to a collective request for EW Action Values (7, 8, or 9) concerning EA, ES, or EW Fix data types, if the own JU has not initiated the evaluation locally, it shall not respond unless the request is specifically addressed.
The geographic filter is successfully implemented by the receiving JU(s), allowing them to filter tracks and nonC² IUs based on the defined geographic location.
If the filter was a line or area requiring multiple messages, all messages with the same filter number are treated as a single filter report by the receiving units.
Filter management on the interface is ensured through the established voice coordination in addition to the transmitted filter message.
